source_text: Quae hominibus alienanda videntur, aliquid operis necessarii apud Deum habent. Peccata etiam in documentum convertuntur, ut memoria culpae custodiat sancta.
pass_a_gloss: Things which to-humans to-be-alienated seem, something of-work necessary with God have. Sins even into warning are-turned, that memory of-fault may-guard holy-things.
pass_b_english: What humans would cast off still has necessary work with God. Even sins are turned into warning, so that memory of the fault may guard the holy things.
